clues: This is the largest resort city in Russia, on the Black Sea. It rests in the south of the land, by the Caucasus hills.
Palm trees grow here, yet cold north winds chill each winter. The air drops below freezing each year in this warm sea town.
In 2014 this town held the Winter Games of the whole world. Ski races ran at a resort in the hills not far off.
For eight years a great car race of the world ran here. The fast cars came each year from 2014 to 2021.
This town runs on and on along the coast for 145 kilometres. It is thought to be the most long town in all of Europe.
